title: German Chancellor Faces Pressure After Historic Far-Right Election Win
subtitle: Friedrich Merz vows to remain in office following a record-breaking result for the AfD in Saxony-Anhalt.

summary.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has announced he will stay in his position despite a major election defeat. The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party won nearly 44% of the vote in the state of Saxony-Anhalt. This result has shaken the ruling Christian Democratic Union party to its foundations. Voters expressed deep dissatisfaction with the current political leadership and the state of the economy. Merz insists he will continue his reform plans while addressing concerns about the country's stability.
summary.zh: 德國總理梅爾茲宣布，儘管遭遇重大選舉挫敗，他仍將留任。極右翼的德國另類選擇黨在薩克森-安哈特邦贏得近百分之四十四的選票，此結果使執政的基督教民主聯盟根基動搖。選民對現任政治領導層及經濟狀況表達了深層不滿。梅爾茲堅持將繼續推動改革計畫，同時處理外界對國家穩定性的擔憂。

paragraphs.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has vowed to remain in office following a historic and difficult election result in the state of Saxony-Anhalt. On Monday, an ashen-faced Merz spoke to reporters in Berlin after the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party achieved a landslide victory. The AfD secured nearly 44% of the vote, a result that has left the Chancellor’s own party, the Christian Democratic Union (CDU), in a state of shock.
paragraphs.zh: 德國總理梅爾茲（Friedrich Merz）誓言在薩克森-安哈特邦（Saxony-Anhalt）經歷歷史性且艱難的選舉結果後，將繼續留任。週一，面色鐵青的梅爾茲在柏林向記者發表談話，此前極右翼政黨「德國另類選擇黨」（AfD）取得了壓倒性勝利。該黨獲得了近百分之四十四的選票，這一結果讓總理所屬的基督教民主聯盟（CDU）陷入震驚狀態。

paragraphs.en: This election result is the latest development in a period of growing political uncertainty for Germany. While the AfD did not win an absolute majority—which means they did not get more than half of the total votes—they are now within striking distance of power. If they succeed, it would be the first time a far-right party has led a German state government since the Nazi period. The Guardian reports that the CDU has been shaken to its very foundations by this defeat, which Merz described as the worst his party has suffered in decades.
paragraphs.zh: 這次選舉結果是德國政治不確定性日益增加時期下的最新發展。雖然德國另類選擇黨並未贏得絕對多數（意即未取得超過半數的總票數），但他們現在已距離執政僅一步之遙。若他們成功執政，這將是自納粹時期以來，首次有極右翼政黨領導德國的邦政府。《衛報》（The Guardian）報導指出，基督教民主聯盟因這場敗選而根基動搖，梅爾茲形容這是該黨數十年來遭受的最慘重挫敗。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the election results reflect deep dissatisfaction among voters. Exit polls—surveys taken as people leave voting stations—showed that only 9% of voters approved of the Chancellor’s performance. Many citizens feel that the current political establishment has failed to manage Europe’s largest economy effectively. Ulrich Siegmund, the 35-year-old candidate for the AfD, successfully tapped into these grievances. He focused his campaign on voters in the former communist east, many of whom feel they are treated as second-class citizens more than thirty years after the fall of the Berlin Wall.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》報導，選舉結果反映了選民深層的不滿。出口民調（即民眾離開投票站時所做的調查）顯示，僅有百分之九的選民認可總理的表現。許多公民認為，現行的政治體制未能有效管理歐洲最大的經濟體。三十五歲的德國另類選擇黨候選人齊格蒙德（Ulrich Siegmund）成功利用了這些不滿情緒。他的競選活動聚焦於前共產主義東部的選民，其中許多人認為在柏林圍牆倒塌三十多年後，他們仍被視為二等公民。

paragraphs.en: Despite the pressure to step down, Merz remains firm in his decision to stay. He acknowledged that his own low poll ratings played a role in the party's loss, admitting that he was a constant topic of discussion during the campaign. He promised to improve his communication with the public and to reach people more effectively. However, he rejected calls from some critics, including the editor-in-chief of Der Spiegel, who suggested that Germany needs a fresh start with a new leader.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管面臨下台壓力，梅爾茲仍堅定留任的決定。他承認自己低迷的民調支持率在黨內敗選中扮演了一定角色，並坦言自己在競選期間一直是討論的焦點。他承諾將改善與大眾的溝通，並更有效地接觸民眾。然而，他拒絕了部分批評者的要求，包括《明鏡周刊》（Der Spiegel）總編輯曾建議德國需要由新領導人帶來新氣象的呼籲。

paragraphs.en: In response to the result, the CDU’s junior partner in the government, the Social Democrats, suggested they might be willing to change some of their plans regarding healthcare and pensions. However, Merz insisted that his determination to continue with his reform plans is unbroken. He argued that creating a sustainable system is essential for the future of the country’s children and grandchildren. "Giving up is not an option for me," he told reporters.
paragraphs.zh: 針對選舉結果，基督教民主聯盟在政府中的初級合作夥伴社會民主黨（Social Democrats）表示，他們可能願意調整部分關於醫療保健與退休金的計畫。然而，梅爾茲堅稱他推動改革計畫的決心絲毫未減。他主張，建立一個永續的制度對於國家子孫後代的未來至關重要。他告訴記者：「放棄對我而言並非選項。」

paragraphs.en: Merz also used his address to reassure Germany’s international allies. He stated that the country’s institutions remain stable and that the government will continue to protect its values and its constitution. He also promised that his stance on the war in Ukraine would not change. He declared that he would not move even a single millimetre from his belief that Germany must defend freedom against Russia. Furthermore, the Chancellor accused Moscow of supporting the AfD’s campaign, noting that two more state elections are scheduled for later this month amid concerns about foreign interference and sabotage.
paragraphs.zh: 梅爾茲也藉由此次談話向德國的國際盟友保證。他聲明該國的體制依然穩定，政府將持續捍衛其價值觀與憲法。他也承諾對烏克蘭戰爭的立場不會改變。他宣稱，對於德國必須捍衛自由以對抗俄羅斯的信念，他絕不會退讓分毫。此外，總理指控莫斯科當局支持德國另類選擇黨的競選活動，並指出本月稍晚還有兩場邦選舉，在各界擔憂外國干預與破壞活動的背景下，局勢備受關注。

paragraphs.en: As the political landscape shifts, the future of the Saxony-Anhalt government remains unclear. While mainstream parties have traditionally refused to form coalitions—groups of parties working together to govern—with the AfD, the sheer size of the party's win has created a complex situation. For now, Merz is focused on steadying his party and proving that he can lead the country through this challenging time. He emphasized that Germany carries a special responsibility because of its history and that his government is committed to maintaining stability for all citizens, including vulnerable minorities.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著政治版圖變動，薩克森-安哈特邦政府的未來仍不明朗。雖然主流政黨傳統上拒絕與德國另類選擇黨組成聯合政府（即多個政黨合作執政），但該黨勝選的規模之大，已造成了複雜的局面。目前，梅爾茲專注於穩定黨內局勢，並證明自己有能力帶領國家度過這段充滿挑戰的時期。他強調，德國因其歷史而肩負特殊責任，他的政府致力於為所有公民，包括弱勢少數群體，維持穩定。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Close enough to reach or achieve something, especially a goal or victory.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 近在咫尺，指非常接近目標或勝利。
keyTerms.noteZh: 此片語常用於軍事或競爭情境，形容距離目標極近。文中：they are now within striking distance of power.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To manage to use or gain access to something (like feelings or resources) that already exists.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 利用、開發（現有的資源或情緒）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指候選人成功利用了選民心中已有的不滿情緒。文中：Ulrich Siegmund, the 35-year-old candidate for the AfD, successfully tapped into these grievances.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To make something stable or calm after a period of instability.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作形容詞（穩定的），這裡作動詞用，指在混亂中穩住局面。文中：For now, Merz is focused on steadying his party and proving that he can lead the country through this challenging time.

previousArticles.title: Germany Faces Political Uncertainty After Historic Far-Right Election Win
previousArticles.summaryEn: The far-right AfD party recently won a historic victory in the German state of Saxony-Anhalt. Despite receiving nearly 44% of the vote, the party did not win an outright majority. Other mainstream political parties have traditionally refused to form coalitions with the AfD. The result has caused deep shock within the national leadership of the conservative CDU party. Future stability remains unclear as the AfD explores options to form a government.

previousArticles.title: Far-right AfD makes historic gains in German state election
previousArticles.summaryEn: The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party has achieved a record-breaking result in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt. While the party won nearly 44% of the vote, it narrowly missed an absolute majority in the state parliament. Mainstream political parties have long maintained a 'firewall' policy, refusing to form coalitions with the AfD. The result has caused concern among European leaders and domestic opponents who fear the party's radical agenda. Meanwhile, the AfD claims this victory is a signal for change across all of Germany.

quiz.question: What specific factor does the article identify as a primary reason for the AfD's success in Saxony-Anhalt?

options.A: The party's promise to immediately exit the European Union.
options.B: The candidate's ability to address the frustrations of voters in the former communist east.
options.C: A massive increase in voter turnout among the youth population.
options.D: The collapse of the Social Democrats' healthcare and pension policies.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第三段明確指出，候選人 Ulrich Siegmund 成功利用了選民的不滿情緒，特別是針對那些在柏林圍牆倒塌三十多年後，仍感覺自己被視為二等公民的東德地區選民。選項 A 文章未提及；選項 C 文章未提到青年投票率；選項 D 雖然提到社民黨願意調整政策，但這不是 AfD 獲勝的原因。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why is the AfD's recent electoral performance considered particularly significant for Germany?

options.A: It marks the first time in history that a far-right party has won a majority in the German parliament.
options.B: It suggests that the current Chancellor has already been forced to resign by his coalition partners.
options.C: It brings a far-right party closer to state-level governance than at any time since the Nazi era.
options.D: It proves that the majority of German citizens no longer support the country's constitution.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第二段，雖然 AfD 沒有贏得絕對多數，但他們已處於「權力邊緣」（within striking distance of power）。文章指出，如果他們成功執政，這將是自納粹時期以來，極右派政黨首次領導德國州政府，這顯示了其政治影響力的歷史性轉變。選項 A 錯誤，因為他們未獲得絕對多數；選項 B 與事實不符，總理拒絕下台；選項 D 過度推論，文章僅提到對現任政府不滿，未提及對憲法的不支持。

quiz.question: In the second paragraph, what does the phrase 'within striking distance of power' mean?

options.A: Very close to achieving a position of authority.
options.B: Using physical violence to take control of the government.
options.C: Having a significant lead in international opinion polls.
options.D: Being removed from the political process by mainstream parties.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境中，「within striking distance」是一個慣用語，意指「非常接近目標」。文章提到 AfD 雖然沒有獲得絕對多數，但他們的得票率已讓他們極有可能在未來取得執政權。選項 B 錯誤，此處並非指武力；選項 C 錯誤，文中討論的是州選舉結果，而非國際民調；選項 D 與文意相反，他們正處於可能執政的狀態。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: A detailed analysis of the economic failures of the German healthcare system.
options.B: A biography of Chancellor Friedrich Merz and his rise to power.
options.C: The international implications of Russia's interference in European elections.
options.D: The political instability in Germany following a significant far-right electoral victory.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文的核心在於報導德國薩克森-安哈特邦選舉中，極右派 AfD 的崛起對現任總理 Merz 及其政府造成的政治衝擊，以及德國面臨的政治不確定性。選項 A 僅是文中提到的局部細節；選項 B 非人物傳記；選項 C 僅是文章結尾提到的其中一個擔憂，並非全文主旨。
